blocks.zh: 學習目標 / Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 中文：能定義「受控溫度腔體」(CTC)，並說明溫度繪圖對 GMP 合規的重要性。
blocks.en: Commentary:Be able to define a "controlled temperature chamber" (CTC) and explain why temperature mapping matters for GMP compliance.

blocks.zh: 中文：識別管制 CTC 的主要法規框架，包括 EU GDP、WHO TRS 961、USP <659> 及 PIC/S PE 011。
blocks.en: Commentary:Identify the main regulatory frameworks governing CTCs, including EU GDP, WHO TRS 961, USP <659> and PIC/S PE 011.

blocks.zh: 中文：列出 CTC 用戶需求規格 (URS) 的最低必要內容，並說明 URS 至確效的可追溯鏈。
blocks.en: Commentary:List the minimum required content of a CTC user requirements specification (URS) and explain the traceability chain from URS to qualification.

blocks.zh: 中文：區別六種主要 CTC 類型，並能將各類型與其溫度範圍、典型產品及確效策略對應。
blocks.en: Commentary:Distinguish the six main CTC types and map each type to its temperature range, typical products and qualification strategy.

blocks.zh: 中文：應用 CDMO 視角：多客戶儲存隔離、進廠檢驗暫存區管理，及跨腔體類型的安定性計畫設計。
blocks.en: Commentary:Apply the CDMO perspective: multi-client storage segregation, management of the incoming inspection staging area, and stability program design across chamber types.

blocks.zh: Chapter 1 — Introduction | 導論
blocks.en: Chapter 1 — Introduction

blocks.zh: What is a CTC? Why does this guide exist? | 什麼是受控溫度腔體？本指南的存在意義
blocks.en: What is a CTC? Why does this guide exist?

blocks.zh: CDMO Commentary | 製藥 CDMO 解析
blocks.en: CDMO Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心定義：受控溫度腔體 (CTC)
blocks.en: Core definition: controlled temperature chamber (CTC)

blocks.zh: 簡單說，CTC 就是「任何你刻意把溫度鎖在某個範圍內的空間或設備」。從一台桌上型冷藏庫到一整棟冷凍倉庫，只要有溫度控制就算。關鍵詞：controlled / maintained / regulated。
blocks.en: Put simply, a CTC is "any space or piece of equipment in which you deliberately hold the temperature within a defined range". It can be a benchtop refrigerator or an entire cold-storage warehouse; if the temperature is controlled, it counts. Keywords: controlled / maintained / regulated.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境裡，CTC 的種類特別多元——你可能同時管理：原料冷凍庫 (-20°C)、成品冷藏區 (2–8°C)、安定性腔體 (25°C/60%RH)，以及室溫倉庫 (15–25°C)。每種都是 CTC，每種都需要映射。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment the variety of CTCs is especially wide. You may be managing, all at once: raw material freezers (-20°C), finished product cold rooms (2–8°C), stability chambers (25°C/60%RH) and ambient warehouses (15–25°C). Every one of them is a CTC, and every one needs mapping.

blocks.zh: 比喻：CTC 就像恆溫保險箱
blocks.en: Analogy: a CTC is a constant-temperature safe

blocks.zh: 想像你把昂貴的藥品放進一個保險箱——這個保險箱不只要鎖住，還要確保裡面的溫度永遠在規定範圍。「溫度映射」就是在整個箱子的每個角落放溫度計，確認沒有任何角落偷偷超溫或過冷。
blocks.en: Imagine putting expensive medicines into a safe. The safe must not only be locked; the temperature inside must also stay within the specified range at all times. "Temperature mapping" means placing a thermometer in every corner of the safe to confirm that no corner is quietly running too hot or too cold.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：這本指南的地位
blocks.en: Key point: the status of this guide

blocks.zh: ISPE GPG 不是法規，它是產業良好實踐。監管機關（EMA、FDA、WHO）不強制你跟它走，但當你在稽核中說「我們依照 ISPE GPG」，這是強有力的防禦性聲明——代表你與業界最佳實踐對齊。
blocks.en: The ISPE GPG is not a regulation; it is industry good practice. Regulators (EMA, FDA, WHO) do not require you to follow it, but when you tell an auditor "we follow the ISPE GPG", it is a strong defensible statement: it shows you are aligned with industry best practice.

blocks.zh: 思考問題 1
blocks.en: Question for reflection 1

blocks.zh: 你的廠房裡有哪些設備或空間符合「CTC」定義？列出至少三種，並說明它們各自的溫度控制目的。
blocks.en: Which pieces of equipment or spaces in your facility meet the definition of a "CTC"? List at least three and state the temperature control purpose of each.

blocks.zh: 1.1 Purpose and Objectives | 目的與目標
blocks.en: 1.1 Purpose and Objectives

blocks.zh: Why was this guide developed? | 本指南的開發動機
blocks.en: Why was this guide developed?

blocks.zh: CDMO Commentary | CDMO 解析
blocks.en: CDMO Commentary

blocks.zh: 生命週期視角：從 URS 到維護
blocks.en: Lifecycle view: from URS to maintenance

blocks.zh: 這個清單就是 CTC 的完整生命週期。注意順序：先定義需求 (URS)，再設計，再購買——不是買了設備再去想規格。這在 CDMO 環境中尤其重要，因為很多公司是「先買設備，後補文件」，這會造成確效困難。
blocks.en: This list is the complete lifecycle of a CTC. Note the order: define the requirements (URS) first, then design, then purchase; do not buy the equipment and then think about the specification. This matters especially in a CDMO, where many companies "buy the equipment first and write the documents afterwards", which makes qualification difficult.

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境應用
blocks.en: CDMO application scenario

blocks.zh: 在合約製藥廠，你可能同時為 5 個以上的客戶儲存不同溫度條件的原料與成品。每批原料都有其溫度儲存要求（客戶 SOP 或 CoA 規定），而你的 CTC 必須能夠証明它在整個儲存期間維持了正確的條件。
blocks.en: At a contract manufacturer you may be storing raw materials and finished products with different temperature conditions for more than five clients at the same time. Each lot has its own storage requirement (set by the client SOP or CoA), and your CTC must be able to demonstrate that it maintained the correct conditions throughout the storage period.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼溫度映射記錄是 CDMO 客戶稽核中最常被要求的文件之一。
blocks.en: This is why temperature mapping records are among the documents most often requested in CDMO client audits.

blocks.zh: 冷鏈管理的連結
blocks.en: Link to cold chain management

blocks.zh: 本指南與 ISPE Cold Chain Management GPG 配套使用。CTC 是冷鏈的靜態節點——產品在倉庫和工廠內的存儲環節。運輸屬於另一份指南的範疇，但原則相通。
blocks.en: This guide is meant to be used together with the ISPE Cold Chain Management GPG. A CTC is a static node of the cold chain: the storage step for product inside warehouses and plants. Transport falls under a different guide, but the principles are the same.

blocks.zh: 1.2 Scope | 適用範圍
blocks.en: 1.2 Scope

blocks.zh: What is IN and OUT of scope | 範圍界定
blocks.en: What is IN and OUT of scope

blocks.zh: 範圍劃分的重要性
blocks.en: Why the scope boundary matters

blocks.zh: 指南明確把「儲存用 CTC」和「加熱/冷卻製程設備」分開。這個分界很實用：
blocks.en: The guide clearly separates "CTCs used for storage" from "process equipment for heating/cooling". This boundary is practical:

blocks.zh: In Scope（在範圍內）：冰箱、冷凍庫、安定性腔體、冷藏室、室溫倉庫
blocks.en: In scope: refrigerators, freezers, stability chambers, cold rooms, ambient-temperature warehouses

blocks.zh: Out of Scope（範圍外）：速凍機 (blast freezer)、滅菌烘箱（用於製程）
blocks.en: Out of scope: blast freezers, sterilization ovens (used for processing)

blocks.zh: 但注意：「some concepts may be useful」——也就是說，你可以把映射原則應用到製程設備，只是不在本指南的主要討論範圍。
blocks.en: Note, however, the wording "some concepts may be useful": you can apply the mapping principles to process equipment, but it is outside the main discussion of this guide.

blocks.zh: cGMP vs GDP 的界線
blocks.en: The boundary between cGMP and GDP

blocks.zh: 本指南聚焦在 cGMP 環境（製造廠的儲存）。GDP（Good Distribution Practice）管的是從工廠出門後的運輸與配送。兩者有重疊，但 CDMO 首要關注的是廠內 GMP 合規。
blocks.en: This guide focuses on the cGMP environment (storage at the manufacturing site). GDP (Good Distribution Practice) governs transport and distribution once product leaves the plant. The two overlap, but a CDMO's first concern is GMP compliance on site.

blocks.zh: 比喻：儲存 vs 製程
blocks.en: Analogy: storage vs process

blocks.zh: 把食材放在冰箱保鮮 = CTC（本指南範圍）。把食材放進炒鍋加熱 = 製程設備（不在範圍）。本指南只管「保鮮冰箱」，不管「炒菜的鍋」。
blocks.en: Keeping ingredients fresh in the refrigerator = a CTC (within the scope of this guide). Heating ingredients in a wok = process equipment (out of scope). This guide covers only the "refrigerator that keeps food fresh", not the "wok used for stir-frying".

blocks.zh: 1.3 Benefits | 使用本指南的效益
blocks.en: 1.3 Benefits of using this guide

blocks.zh: Why follow this guide? | 為什麼要遵循本指南？
blocks.en: Why follow this guide?

blocks.zh: 監管趨勢：冷鏈的全球化壓力
blocks.en: Regulatory trend: global pressure on the cold chain

blocks.zh: 生物製劑（mAb、疫苗、基因治療）在全球藥品市場的比例快速增長，這類產品幾乎都需要嚴格的溫度控制。監管機關（EMA、WHO、TFDA）對冷鏈的稽核強度也隨之提升。
blocks.en: Biologics (mAbs, vaccines, gene therapies) are a fast-growing share of the global pharmaceutical market, and almost all of them require tight temperature control. Regulators (EMA, WHO, TFDA) have correspondingly increased the intensity of their cold chain inspections.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 來說，這代表：你的客戶（BigPharma）在稽核你的設施時，CTC 映射記錄是必查項目。
blocks.en: For a CDMO this means: when your clients (big pharma) audit your facility, CTC mapping records are a must-check item.

blocks.zh: 三大具體效益
blocks.en: Three concrete benefits

blocks.zh: 效益 1：有標準化的映射方法論，知道要放幾個感測器、放哪裡
blocks.en: Benefit 1: A standardized mapping methodology, so you know how many sensors to use and where to place them

blocks.zh: 效益 2：有明確的接受標準 (acceptance criteria) 框架，讓你知道「通過」的定義
blocks.en: Benefit 2: A clear framework of acceptance criteria, so you know what "pass" means

blocks.zh: 效益 3：有風險導向的定期複審頻率，不用每年都全面重做映射
blocks.en: Benefit 3: A risk-based periodic review frequency, so you do not have to repeat full mapping every year

blocks.zh: 思考問題 2
blocks.en: Question for reflection 2

blocks.zh: 你的廠目前如何決定冷藏庫溫度監測感測器的位置？這個決策是基於映射數據，還是基於習慣？
blocks.en: How does your site currently decide where to place the temperature monitoring sensors in a cold room? Is the decision based on mapping data or on habit?

blocks.zh: 1.4 Regulatory Guidance | 法規指引
blocks.en: 1.4 Regulatory Guidance

blocks.zh: Key regulations and standards governing CTCs | 管制 CTC 的主要法規與標準
blocks.en: Key regulations and standards governing CTCs

blocks.zh: 法規解析與 CDMO 應用
blocks.en: Regulatory analysis and CDMO application

blocks.zh: 法規層次架構
blocks.en: Regulatory hierarchy

blocks.zh: 這些法規可以分為三個層次：
blocks.en: These regulations fall into three levels:

blocks.zh: 強制性法規：EU GDP Guidelines（EMA/歐盟委員會）— 在歐盟市場銷售產品必須合規
blocks.en: Mandatory regulations: EU GDP Guidelines (EMA/European Commission); compliance is required to sell product on the EU market

blocks.zh: 準強制性指引：WHO TRS 961 — WHO 會員國的監管基礎，TFDA 多以此為參考
blocks.en: Quasi-mandatory guidance: WHO TRS 961, the regulatory basis for WHO member states; TFDA often uses it as a reference

blocks.zh: 產品規格性標準：USP <659> — 定義了「冷藏」「冷凍」「室溫」等術語的官方溫度範圍
blocks.en: Product specification standards: USP <659>, which defines the official temperature ranges for terms such as "refrigerator", "freezer" and "room temperature"

blocks.zh: WHO TRS 961 Annex 9 的關鍵要求
blocks.en: Key requirements of WHO TRS 961 Annex 9

blocks.zh: WHO TRS 961 Annex 9 對「時間和溫度敏感產品」（TTSP）的儲存和運輸提供了最完整的指引，包括：
blocks.en: WHO TRS 961 Annex 9 provides the most complete guidance on the storage and transport of time- and temperature-sensitive pharmaceutical products (TTSPPs), including:

blocks.zh: 溫度映射的最低要求（感測器數量、持續時間）
blocks.en: Minimum requirements for temperature mapping (number of sensors, duration)

blocks.zh: 溫度偏差的處理程序
blocks.en: Procedures for handling temperature deviations

blocks.zh: 風險評估的應用
blocks.en: Application of risk assessment

blocks.zh: 再驗證的觸發條件
blocks.en: Triggers for requalification

blocks.zh: 對於出口到新興市場（非洲、東南亞）的 CDMO，WHO 指引往往是當地 NRA 的稽核基礎。
blocks.en: For a CDMO exporting to emerging markets (Africa, Southeast Asia), the WHO guidance is often the basis of the local NRA's inspections.

blocks.zh: USP <659> 溫度定義
blocks.en: USP <659> temperature definitions

blocks.zh: USP <659> 是客戶 CoA 中「儲存條件」欄位的法律依據：
blocks.en: USP <659> is the legal basis for the "storage conditions" field on a client's CoA:

blocks.zh: Freezer（冷凍）: -25°C to -10°C
blocks.en: Freezer: -25°C to -10°C

blocks.zh: Refrigerator（冷藏）: 2°C to 8°C
blocks.en: Refrigerator: 2°C to 8°C

blocks.zh: Cool（涼爽）: 8°C to 15°C
blocks.en: Cool: 8°C to 15°C

blocks.zh: Controlled Room Temperature（受控室溫）: 20°C to 25°C
blocks.en: Controlled Room Temperature: 20°C to 25°C

blocks.zh: 當客戶說「Store at 2–8°C」，這就是 USP 標準，你的 CTC 必須証明能維持在這個範圍內。
blocks.en: When a client says "Store at 2–8°C", this is the USP standard, and your CTC must demonstrate that it can maintain this range.

blocks.zh: 思考問題 3
blocks.en: Question for reflection 3

blocks.zh: 你的廠目前在 CTC 確效文件中引用了哪些法規？這些法規是否涵蓋了你出口市場的要求？
blocks.en: Which regulations does your site currently cite in its CTC qualification documents? Do they cover the requirements of your export markets?

blocks.zh: 1.5 Key Concepts / Key Terms | 關鍵概念與術語
blocks.en: 1.5 Key Concepts / Key Terms

blocks.zh: Commissioning, Qualification, and Rounding Rules | 試運轉、確效與數值捨入規則
blocks.en: Commissioning, Qualification, and Rounding Rules

blocks.zh: 術語深度解析
blocks.en: In-depth look at the terminology

blocks.zh: 試運轉 vs 確效：傻傻分不清？
blocks.en: Commissioning vs qualification: still confusing them?

blocks.zh: 這兩個詞在廠內常被混用，但 ISPE 的定義非常清楚：
blocks.en: These two terms are often used interchangeably on site, but the ISPE definitions are very clear:

blocks.zh: Commissioning（試運轉）：工程導向，確保設備「能動」且符合設計規格。重點：Does it work as designed?
blocks.en: Commissioning: engineering-oriented; ensures the equipment "works" and meets the design specification. The focus: Does it work as designed?

blocks.zh: Qualification（確效）：法規導向，証明設備「適合其預定用途」。重點：Is it fit for GMP use?
blocks.en: Qualification: regulation-oriented; demonstrates that the equipment is "fit for its intended use". The focus: Is it fit for GMP use?

blocks.zh: 試運轉先做，確效後做。試運轉的文件可以支撐確效，但不能取代確效。
blocks.en: Commissioning comes first and qualification second. Commissioning documentation can support qualification but cannot replace it.

blocks.zh: 比喻：試運轉 vs 確效
blocks.en: Analogy: commissioning vs qualification

blocks.zh: 新車交車前的出廠測試 = Commissioning（確認引擎能動、煞車有效）。
blocks.en: The factory test before a new car is delivered = commissioning (confirming that the engine runs and the brakes work).

blocks.zh: 駕訓班的路考 = Qualification（在特定條件下証明你能安全駕駛）。
blocks.en: The road test at driving school = qualification (demonstrating that you can drive safely under defined conditions).

blocks.zh: 你可以通過出廠測試但路考失敗（設備能動但不符合 GMP 要求）；你也可以路考通過但不會修車（符合 GMP 但日常維護不佳）。
blocks.en: You can pass the factory test but fail the road test (the equipment works but does not meet GMP requirements); you can also pass the road test but be unable to repair the car (GMP-compliant but poorly maintained day to day).

blocks.zh: 數值捨入規則的實際意義
blocks.en: Practical meaning of the rounding rule

blocks.zh: 這個看似微小的規則在實際操作中非常重要。舉例：
blocks.en: This seemingly minor rule matters a great deal in practice. For example:

blocks.zh: 上限 8°C，測量到 8.4°C → 捨入後 = 8°C → 通過
blocks.en: Upper limit 8°C, measured 8.4°C → rounded = 8°C → Pass

blocks.zh: 上限 8°C，測量到 8.5°C → 捨入後 = 9°C → 失敗
blocks.en: Upper limit 8°C, measured 8.5°C → rounded = 9°C → Fail

blocks.zh: 在設定警報上限和確效接受標準時，這個規則決定了你在「邊界值」的判斷——不能隨意四捨五入。
blocks.en: When setting alarm limits and qualification acceptance criteria, this rule determines how you judge "borderline values"; you cannot round arbitrarily.

blocks.zh: Chapter 2 — Related Standards | 相關標準
blocks.en: Chapter 2 — Related Standards

blocks.zh: International standards applicable to CTCs | 適用於受控溫度腔體的國際標準
blocks.en: International standards applicable to controlled temperature chambers

blocks.zh: 標準解析與應用
blocks.en: Analysis and application of the standards

blocks.zh: 關鍵認知：沒有專屬藥廠的 CTC 標準
blocks.en: Key insight: there is no standard written specifically for pharmaceutical CTCs

blocks.zh: ISPE 在此坦白承認了一個重要事實：目前沒有任何國際標準是專門為製藥 CTC 寫的。現有標準都是為「環境測試腔體」或「安定性腔體」所寫，製藥業只是「借用」這些標準的原則。
blocks.en: ISPE openly acknowledges an important fact here: no international standard has been written specifically for pharmaceutical CTCs. The existing standards were written for "environmental test chambers" or "stability chambers", and the pharmaceutical industry simply "borrows" their principles.

blocks.zh: 這正是 ISPE GPG 存在的理由——填補了法規要求和工業標準之間的空白。
blocks.en: This is precisely why the ISPE GPG exists: it fills the gap between regulatory requirements and industrial standards.

blocks.zh: 比喻：借用標準就像穿別人的制服
blocks.en: Analogy: borrowing a standard is like wearing someone else's uniform

blocks.zh: IEC 60068 是為電子工廠設計的，製藥廠「借穿」它就像穿了稍微不合身的制服。原則可以用，但細節（如感測器位置、典型負荷條件）需要結合藥廠的實際使用場景調整。
blocks.en: IEC 60068 was designed for electronics factories; a pharmaceutical plant "borrowing" it is like wearing a slightly ill-fitting uniform. The principles can be used, but details (such as sensor positions and typical load conditions) must be adapted to the actual use case in the pharmaceutical facility.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 ISPE GPG 強調：「although the same principles may be applied, the details of how the systems are to be used in an operational environment should also be considered.」
blocks.en: This is why the ISPE GPG stresses: "although the same principles may be applied, the details of how the systems are to be used in an operational environment should also be considered."

blocks.zh: 兩種主要使用模式
blocks.en: Two main usage modes

blocks.zh: ISPE 在章節末尾點出了 CTC 的兩種核心使用場景：
blocks.en: At the end of the chapter, ISPE points out two core usage scenarios for CTCs:

blocks.zh: 長期儲存（安定性）：需要高穩定性、嚴格的溫濕度控制，映射要求最嚴格（ICH Q1A 條件：25°C/60%RH、40°C/75%RH 等）
blocks.en: Long-term storage (stability): requires high stability and tight temperature and humidity control, with the most stringent mapping requirements (ICH Q1A conditions: 25°C/60%RH, 40°C/75%RH, etc.)

blocks.zh: 短期儲存（WIP / 倉儲）：通量大、開門頻繁、負荷變化大，映射需要考慮最壞情況（worst case loading）
blocks.en: Short-term storage (WIP / warehousing): high throughput, frequent door openings and widely varying loads, so mapping must consider the worst case (worst-case loading)

blocks.zh: 不同使用模式，映射策略不同——這是後續章節的核心主題。
blocks.en: Different usage modes call for different mapping strategies; this is the core theme of the following chapters.

blocks.zh: GSP vs GDP：亞太市場的差異
blocks.en: GSP vs GDP: differences in the Asia-Pacific market

blocks.zh: 指南腳注提醒：中國和韓國使用 GSP（Good Supply Practice）而非 GDP。對於台灣 CDMO 出口到中國或韓國的產品，需確認客戶要求是否有 GSP 特定要求。台灣 TFDA 本身以 PIC/S 為基準，與 EU GDP 高度對齊。
blocks.en: A footnote in the guide points out that China and Korea use GSP (Good Supply Practice) rather than GDP. For a Taiwanese CDMO exporting products to China or Korea, confirm whether the client has GSP-specific requirements. Taiwan's TFDA itself uses PIC/S as its benchmark, which is closely aligned with EU GDP.

blocks.zh: 思考問題 4
blocks.en: Question for reflection 4

blocks.zh: 你的廠的安定性腔體確效文件中，引用了哪些標準？這些標準是否足以支撐歐盟客戶的稽核？
blocks.en: Which standards are cited in your site's stability chamber qualification documents? Are they sufficient to withstand an audit by an EU client?

blocks.zh: Chapter 3 — User Requirements Specification | 用戶需求規格書
blocks.en: Chapter 3 — User Requirements Specification

blocks.zh: Write the URS before you buy — not after | 先寫 URS，再採購設備
blocks.en: Write the URS before you buy — not after

blocks.zh: URS 是業務需求與設備交付之間的合約——在採購之前寫，而不是之後補。
blocks.en: The URS is the contract between the business need and the delivered equipment: write it before purchase, not after the fact.

blocks.zh: URS 深度解析 | CDMO 應用
blocks.en: URS in depth | CDMO application

blocks.zh: 什麼是 URS？為什麼它如此重要？
blocks.en: What is a URS? Why is it so important?

blocks.zh: URS 是整個設備生命週期的起點文件。它回答一個核心問題：「這台設備需要做到什麼？」
blocks.en: The URS is the starting document for the entire equipment lifecycle. It answers one core question: "What does this equipment need to do?"

blocks.zh: 注意 ISPE 的細微但重要的說法：URS 定義什麼(what)，不定義如何(how)。這給供應商設計自由度，同時確保最終交付符合使用者真實需求。
blocks.en: Note the subtle but important ISPE wording: the URS defines what is needed, not how it is achieved. This gives the supplier design freedom while ensuring that the final delivery meets the user's real needs.

blocks.zh: 比喻：URS 就像建築設計委託書
blocks.en: Analogy: a URS is like a brief to an architect

blocks.zh: 你委託建築師蓋房子，你說「我需要一個能住4人、有兩個浴室、夏天室內不超過26°C的房子，預算500萬」——這是 URS 的精神。
blocks.en: You commission an architect to build a house and say, "I need a house for 4 people, with two bathrooms, where the indoor temperature does not exceed 26°C in summer, with a budget of NT$5 million"; this is the spirit of a URS.

blocks.zh: 你不說「用什麼牌子的磚頭」或「空調要裝在哪個位置」——那是設計規格 (Design Specification, DS) 和安裝規格 (Installation Specification, IS) 的工作。
blocks.en: You do not say "use this brand of brick" or "put the air conditioner in this position"; that is the job of the Design Specification (DS) and the Installation Specification (IS).

blocks.zh: URS → 確效的可追溯鏈
blocks.en: URS → qualification traceability chain

blocks.zh: ISPE 強調：確效文件必須能可追溯地証明每一條 URS 要求都已被滿足。這代表你的 OQ/PQ 協議中，每個測試項目都應該有一個對應的 URS 編號。
blocks.en: ISPE stresses that qualification documents must traceably demonstrate that every URS requirement has been met. This means that every test item in your OQ/PQ protocols should have a corresponding URS number.

blocks.zh: 如果你的確效報告找不到某條 URS 要求的対应測試，這就是稽核發現 (observation) 的來源。
blocks.en: If your qualification report cannot show a corresponding test for a URS requirement, that is the source of an audit finding (observation).

blocks.zh: 小型設備的特殊處理
blocks.en: Special handling for small equipment

blocks.zh: 對於標準目錄品（如小型實驗室冰箱），ISPE 允許 URS 以採購單的形式呈現——也就是採購單上的技術規格就是 URS。但對於走入式冷凍庫、大型倉庫等客製化設備，仍需要獨立的正式 URS 文件。
blocks.en: For standard catalog items (such as a small laboratory refrigerator), ISPE allows the URS to take the form of a purchase order; that is, the technical specifications on the purchase order are the URS. For customized equipment such as walk-in freezers and large warehouses, a separate formal URS document is still required.

blocks.zh: 思考問題 5
blocks.en: Question for reflection 5

blocks.zh: 你的廠上次購買冷藏設備時，是先寫 URS 還是先選設備？如果是後者，你如何補救確效文件中的可追溯性？
blocks.en: The last time your site bought refrigeration equipment, did you write the URS first or choose the equipment first? If the latter, how would you remediate the traceability in the qualification documents?

blocks.zh: CDMO 冷藏庫 URS 必要元素
blocks.en: Essential elements of a CDMO cold room URS

blocks.zh: 以下是一個 CDMO 2–8°C 冷藏庫 URS 的典型必要元素：
blocks.en: The following are the typical essential elements of a URS for a CDMO 2–8°C cold room:

blocks.zh: URS Element Checklist | URS 要素核查清單
blocks.en: URS Element Checklist

blocks.zh: Performance Requirements | 性能要求
blocks.en: Performance Requirements

blocks.zh: Temperature range defined (min/max) | 溫度範圍已定義（最低/最高）
blocks.en: Temperature range defined (min/max)

blocks.zh: Temperature uniformity requirement | 溫度均勻性要求
blocks.en: Temperature uniformity requirement

blocks.zh: Temperature recovery time after door opening | 開門後溫度回復時間
blocks.en: Temperature recovery time after door opening

blocks.zh: Humidity control (if applicable) | 濕度控制（如適用）
blocks.en: Humidity control (if applicable)

blocks.zh: Light protection requirements | 避光要求（如適用）
blocks.en: Light protection requirements (if applicable)

blocks.zh: Vibration/noise limits (for sensitive products) | 振動/噪音限制
blocks.en: Vibration/noise limits (for sensitive products)

blocks.zh: Capacity & Loading | 容量與負荷
blocks.en: Capacity & Loading

blocks.zh: Maximum storage volume/weight | 最大儲存體積/重量
blocks.en: Maximum storage volume/weight

blocks.zh: Typical load configuration | 典型負荷配置
blocks.en: Typical load configuration

blocks.zh: Door opening frequency and duration | 開門頻率與時間
blocks.en: Door opening frequency and duration

blocks.zh: Number of access points/doors | 進出口/門數量
blocks.en: Number of access points/doors

blocks.zh: Shelving or pallet racking requirements | 貨架或棧板架要求
blocks.en: Shelving or pallet racking requirements

blocks.zh: Monitoring & Alarms | 監測與警報
blocks.en: Monitoring & Alarms

blocks.zh: Continuous temperature monitoring requirement | 持續溫度監測要求
blocks.en: Continuous temperature monitoring requirement

blocks.zh: Alarm setpoints (high/low/rate of change) | 警報設定點（高/低/變化速率）
blocks.en: Alarm setpoints (high/low/rate of change)

blocks.zh: Alarm notification method (visual/audible/remote) | 警報通知方式
blocks.en: Alarm notification method (visual/audible/remote)

blocks.zh: Data recording interval and retention period | 數據記錄間隔與保存期
blocks.en: Data recording interval and retention period

blocks.zh: Data integrity requirements (21 CFR Part 11 / EU Annex 11) | 數據完整性要求
blocks.en: Data integrity requirements (21 CFR Part 11 / EU Annex 11)

blocks.zh: Access & Safety | 進入管制與安全
blocks.en: Access & Safety

blocks.zh: Access control requirement (key/card/biometric) | 進入管制要求
blocks.en: Access control requirement (key/card/biometric)

blocks.zh: Segregation requirements (multi-client) | 隔離要求（多客戶環境）
blocks.en: Segregation requirements (multi-client environment)

blocks.zh: Emergency power backup | 緊急電力備援
blocks.en: Emergency power backup

blocks.zh: Safety interlocks (anti-entrapment for walk-ins) | 安全連鎖（走入式防困人）
blocks.en: Safety interlocks (anti-entrapment for walk-ins)

blocks.zh: Utility connections (power, drain) | 公用設施連接（電力、排水）
blocks.en: Utility connections (power, drain)

blocks.zh: Environmental Conditions | 環境條件
blocks.en: Environmental Conditions

blocks.zh: Ambient temperature range at installation site | 安裝地點環境溫度範圍
blocks.en: Ambient temperature range at installation site

blocks.zh: Ambient humidity at installation site | 安裝地點環境濕度
blocks.en: Ambient humidity at installation site

blocks.zh: Clean room classification (if applicable) | 潔淨室分級（如適用）
blocks.en: Clean room classification (if applicable)

blocks.zh: Seismic/structural requirements | 抗震/結構要求
blocks.en: Seismic/structural requirements

blocks.zh: Maintenance & Qualification | 維護與確效
blocks.en: Maintenance & Qualification

blocks.zh: Maintenance access requirements | 維護可及性要求
blocks.en: Maintenance access requirements

blocks.zh: Defrost cycle requirements (no product exposure) | 除霜循環要求（不影響產品）
blocks.en: Defrost cycle requirements (no product exposure)

blocks.zh: Calibration access for sensors | 感測器校準可及性
blocks.en: Calibration access for sensors

blocks.zh: Qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) expected | 預期的確效活動（IQ/OQ/PQ）
blocks.en: Qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) expected

blocks.zh: Documentation package requirements | 文件包要求
blocks.en: Documentation package requirements

blocks.zh: Chapter 4 — Types of Controlled Temperature Chamber | 受控溫度腔體類型
blocks.en: Chapter 4 — Types of Controlled Temperature Chamber

blocks.zh: Overview: how CTC type drives qualification strategy | 腔體類型如何決定確效策略
blocks.en: Overview: how CTC type drives qualification strategy

blocks.zh: CDMO 視角：腔體類型的戰略意義
blocks.en: CDMO perspective: the strategic significance of chamber type

blocks.zh: 為什麼腔體類型決定確效策略？
blocks.en: Why does chamber type determine the qualification strategy?

blocks.zh: 不同類型的 CTC 有根本性的差異：
blocks.en: Different types of CTC differ fundamentally:

blocks.zh: 體積差異：從桌上型實驗室冰箱到千坪倉庫，感測器需求完全不同
blocks.en: Volume: from a benchtop laboratory refrigerator to a warehouse of thousands of square meters, the sensor requirements are completely different

blocks.zh: 使用模式：安定性腔體幾乎不開門；走入式冷藏室每天進出數十次
blocks.en: Usage pattern: a stability chamber is almost never opened; a walk-in cold room is entered dozens of times a day

blocks.zh: 溫度範圍：-80°C 超低溫凍庫和 25°C 室溫倉庫的映射挑戰截然不同
blocks.en: Temperature range: the mapping challenges of a -80°C ultra-low freezer and a 25°C ambient warehouse are entirely different

blocks.zh: 法規要求：安定性腔體需符合 ICH Q1A；倉庫要符合 GDP
blocks.en: Regulatory requirements: stability chambers must meet ICH Q1A; warehouses must meet GDP

blocks.zh: CDMO 特殊場景：多客戶儲存的複雜性
blocks.en: A special CDMO scenario: the complexity of multi-client storage

blocks.zh: 在合約製藥廠，一個冷藏區域可能同時儲存：
blocks.en: At a contract manufacturer, a single cold storage area may hold at the same time:

blocks.zh: 客戶 A 的原料藥（需要 2–8°C，進口檢驗後暫存）
blocks.en: Client A's drug substance (requires 2–8°C, held after incoming inspection)

blocks.zh: 客戶 B 的半成品（需要 2–8°C，等待 QC 放行）
blocks.en: Client B's intermediates (require 2–8°C, awaiting QC release)

blocks.zh: 客戶 C 的成品（需要 2–8°C，等待出貨）
blocks.en: Client C's finished products (require 2–8°C, awaiting shipment)

blocks.zh: 這三種物料可能在同一個冷藏室，但必須有明確的物理或視覺隔離。映射時必須証明整個空間——包括每個客戶的存放區——都在 2–8°C 之間。
blocks.en: These three types of material may sit in the same cold room, but there must be clear physical or visual segregation. Mapping must demonstrate that the entire space, including each client's storage area, stays between 2 and 8°C.

blocks.zh: CDMO 進廠檢驗暫存區
blocks.en: CDMO incoming inspection staging area

blocks.zh: 一個常被忽略的 CTC 是進廠檢驗暫存區（Incoming Inspection Staging Area）。當需要冷藏的原料到廠後，等待 QC 抽樣和放行期間，它必須存放在符合儲存條件的區域。
blocks.en: A frequently overlooked CTC is the incoming inspection staging area. When raw materials that require refrigeration arrive at the site, they must be held in an area that meets the storage conditions while waiting for QC sampling and release.

blocks.zh: 這個暫存區往往是一個獨立的小型冷藏庫或冷藏室的隔離區域，它同樣是 CTC，同樣需要映射和確效。
blocks.en: This staging area is often a separate small refrigerator or a segregated section of a cold room. It is also a CTC and also needs mapping and qualification.

blocks.zh: 思考問題 6
blocks.en: Question for reflection 6

blocks.zh: 你的廠的進廠冷藏原料，從卸貨到通過 QC 放行進入正式冷藏庫這段期間，存放在哪裡？這個區域有映射記錄嗎？
blocks.en: Where are your incoming refrigerated raw materials held, from unloading until QC release into the formal cold storage? Does that area have mapping records?

blocks.zh: CTC Type Comparison Table | 受控溫度腔體類型比較表
blocks.en: CTC Type Comparison Table

blocks.zh: CDMO-Specific Scenarios | CDMO 特定應用場景
blocks.en: CDMO-Specific Scenarios

blocks.zh: 場景 1：多客戶安定性計畫
blocks.en: Scenario 1: multi-client stability program

blocks.zh: 你同時為 8 個客戶管理安定性樣品，使用同一台 40°C/75%RH 腔體。映射文件必須証明腔體在滿載（所有客戶樣品）條件下仍符合 ICH 條件。
blocks.en: You manage stability samples for 8 clients in the same 40°C/75%RH chamber. The mapping documentation must demonstrate that the chamber still meets ICH conditions under full load (all clients' samples).

blocks.zh: 關鍵要求：映射時使用最大預期負荷；每個客戶的安定性協議中引用同一份確效報告是否合適？需要個別客戶確認嗎？
blocks.en: Key requirements: use the maximum expected load during mapping; is it appropriate for each client's stability protocol to cite the same qualification report? Is individual client confirmation needed?

blocks.zh: 場景 2：進廠原料暫存
blocks.en: Scenario 2: incoming raw material staging

blocks.zh: 供應商運來需要冷藏的原料，但 QC 採樣完成需要 48–72 小時。這段期間原料必須存放在符合條件的 CTC 中。
blocks.en: A supplier delivers raw materials that require refrigeration, but QC sampling takes 48–72 hours to complete. During this time the materials must be stored in a CTC that meets the conditions.

blocks.zh: 常見問題：進廠暫存區往往沒有獨立的確效記錄，或與正式冷藏庫混用。這是稽核中的高風險發現點。
blocks.en: Common problem: the incoming staging area often has no separate qualification records, or is shared with the formal cold room. This is a high-risk finding point in audits.

blocks.zh: 場景 3：無菌填充前的原料暫存
blocks.en: Scenario 3: raw material staging before aseptic filling

blocks.zh: 蛋白質藥液在灌裝前需要在 2–8°C 下短暫儲存（通常不超過 24–48 小時）。這個存儲容器（不鏽鋼桶或生物反應袋）的存放環境是 CTC。
blocks.en: Protein drug solution must be held briefly at 2–8°C before filling (usually no more than 24–48 hours). The environment in which this holding vessel (stainless steel tank or bioreactor bag) is kept is a CTC.

blocks.zh: 特殊考量：這是製造環境（不只是倉儲），需同時符合 GMP 潔淨室要求和 CTC 溫度要求。
blocks.en: Special consideration: this is a manufacturing environment (not just warehousing), so it must meet both GMP cleanroom requirements and CTC temperature requirements.

blocks.zh: CTC Type to Qualification Approach | 腔體類型對應確效方法
blocks.en: CTC Type to Qualification Approach

blocks.zh: Practice Questions | 綜合練習問題
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: Test your understanding of Chapters 1–4 | 測試你對第 1–4 章的理解
blocks.en: Test your understanding of Chapters 1–4

blocks.zh: Conceptual Questions | 概念問題
blocks.en: Conceptual Questions

blocks.zh: 一間公司使用家用冰箱儲存 QC 測試用試劑。這算是 CTC 嗎？需要溫度映射嗎？哪些因素決定確效程度？
blocks.en: A company uses a household refrigerator to store QC test reagents. Is this a CTC? Does it need temperature mapping? What factors determine the extent of qualification?

blocks.zh: 供應商完成走入式冷藏室的試運轉，報告顯示溫度符合 2–8°C。這份報告可以作為你的 OQ 嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: A supplier completes commissioning of a walk-in cold room, and the report shows the temperature meets 2–8°C. Can this report serve as your OQ? Why?

blocks.zh: 你的廠緊急採購了一台 -20°C 冷凍庫，URS 在安裝後才寫。有哪些確效風險？如何補救？
blocks.en: Your site urgently purchases a -20°C freezer, and the URS is written after installation. What are the qualification risks? How would you remediate?

blocks.zh: 你的 2–8°C 冰箱顯示最高讀數 8.45°C。依 USP 捨入規則，這是溫度偏差嗎？8.50°C 呢？
blocks.en: Your 2–8°C refrigerator shows a maximum reading of 8.45°C. Under the USP rounding rule, is this a temperature deviation? What about 8.50°C?

blocks.zh: Application Questions | 應用問題
blocks.en: Application Questions

blocks.zh: 新的生物製劑原料藥需要 -80°C 儲存，你目前只有 -20°C 冷凍庫。列出新超低溫冷凍庫 URS 中的五項要求，並說明每項的重要性。
blocks.en: A new biologic drug substance requires -80°C storage, and you currently have only a -20°C freezer. List five requirements for the new ultra-low freezer URS and explain why each is important.

blocks.zh: 歐洲客戶稽核你的 CDMO，問：「你們冷儲區域依循哪個 GDP 指引？」你的廠目前只引用 ICH Q1A。這樣足夠嗎？正確答案是什麼？
blocks.en: A European client audits your CDMO and asks: "Which GDP guideline does your cold storage area follow?" Your site currently cites only ICH Q1A. Is that enough? What is the correct answer?

blocks.zh: 你有一台安定性腔體同時為五個客戶運行安定性計畫。客戶F想新增200份樣品，將腔體填充至95%。你會問哪些問題？需要重新映射嗎？
blocks.en: You have a stability chamber running stability programs for five clients at the same time. Client F wants to add 200 samples, filling the chamber to 95%. What questions would you ask? Does it need to be re-mapped?

blocks.zh: ISPE 指出沒有專為製藥 CTC 制定的標準。面對這個空白，你如何向法規稽查員論證新走入式冷藏室的確效方法？
blocks.en: ISPE notes that no standard has been written specifically for pharmaceutical CTCs. Given this gap, how would you justify the qualification approach for a new walk-in cold room to a regulatory inspector?

blocks.zh: Scenario Question | 情境題 Q9 — CDMO Cold Storage Review
blocks.en: Scenario Question Q9 — CDMO Cold Storage Review

blocks.zh: 你是一家 CDMO 的 QA 總監。內部稽核中發現以下問題。針對每個問題，識別：(a) ISPE CTC GPG 最相關的章節，(b) 法規風險，(c) 你建議的改善措施。
blocks.en: You are the QA Director of a CDMO. An internal audit found the following issues. For each issue, identify: (a) the most relevant section of the ISPE CTC GPG, (b) the regulatory risk, and (c) your recommended corrective action.

blocks.zh: Regulatory Reference Summary | 法規引用快速參考
blocks.en: Regulatory Reference Summary

blocks.zh: Chapter Summary | 章節重點摘要
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: Key takeaways from Chapters 1–4 | 第 1–4 章核心要點
blocks.en: Key takeaways from Chapters 1–4

blocks.zh: Chapter 1 — Introduction 導論
blocks.en: Chapter 1 — Introduction

blocks.zh: CTC = 任何溫度受控的設備或空間，從小冰箱到大倉庫都算
blocks.en: CTC = any temperature-controlled equipment or space, from a small refrigerator to a large warehouse

blocks.zh: 本指南的定位：產業良好實踐（非法規），但具強力防禦效力
blocks.en: Position of this guide: industry good practice (not a regulation), but with strong defensive value

blocks.zh: Commissioning（試運轉）≠ Qualification（確效）：前者工程導向，後者法規導向
blocks.en: Commissioning ≠ Qualification: the former is engineering-oriented, the latter regulation-oriented

blocks.zh: 溫度數值捨入遵循 USP <32> 規則，邊界值判斷不能隨意
blocks.en: Temperature value rounding follows the USP <32> rule; borderline values cannot be judged arbitrarily

blocks.zh: Chapter 2 — Related Standards 相關標準
blocks.en: Chapter 2 — Related Standards

blocks.zh: 沒有專為製藥 CTC 制定的國際標準——空白由 ISPE GPG 填補
blocks.en: There is no international standard written specifically for pharmaceutical CTCs; the gap is filled by the ISPE GPG

blocks.zh: 現有標準（IEC 60068、AS 2853、DIN 12880）是借用，原則適用但細節需調整
blocks.en: Existing standards (IEC 60068, AS 2853, DIN 12880) are borrowed: the principles apply but the details need adjusting

blocks.zh: GDP（Good Distribution Practice）是主要監管框架；中國/韓國使用 GSP
blocks.en: GDP (Good Distribution Practice) is the main regulatory framework; China/Korea use GSP

blocks.zh: CTC 用途分兩類：長期儲存（安定性）vs 短期 WIP/倉儲，映射策略不同
blocks.en: CTC use falls into two categories: long-term storage (stability) vs short-term WIP/warehousing, with different mapping strategies

blocks.zh: Chapter 3 — URS 用戶需求規格
blocks.en: Chapter 3 — URS User Requirements Specification

blocks.zh: URS 定義「需要什麼」(WHAT)，不定義「如何做到」(HOW)
blocks.en: The URS defines "what is needed" (WHAT), not "how to achieve it" (HOW)

blocks.zh: 先寫 URS，再採購設備——這是生命週期管理的正確順序
blocks.en: Write the URS first, then purchase the equipment: this is the correct order for lifecycle management

blocks.zh: 確效文件必須可追溯地対应每一條 URS 要求
blocks.en: Qualification documents must traceably address every URS requirement

blocks.zh: 標準目錄品可用採購單形式作為 URS；客製化設備需獨立 URS 文件
blocks.en: Standard catalog items may use a purchase order as the URS; customized equipment needs a separate URS document

blocks.zh: Chapter 4 — CTC Types 腔體類型
blocks.en: Chapter 4 — CTC Types

blocks.zh: 六種主要類型：超低溫凍庫、標準冷凍庫、冷藏庫、走入式冷藏室、安定性腔體、受控溫度室
blocks.en: Six main types: ultra-low freezer, standard freezer, refrigerator, walk-in cold room, stability chamber, controlled temperature room

blocks.zh: 腔體類型決定映射策略、感測器數量/位置、確效方法和再確效頻率
blocks.en: Chamber type determines the mapping strategy, the number and position of sensors, the qualification method and the requalification frequency

blocks.zh: CDMO 特殊挑戰：多客戶隔離、進廠暫存、無菌製程前暫存
blocks.en: Special CDMO challenges: multi-client segregation, incoming staging, staging before aseptic processing

blocks.zh: 每種腔體類型對應不同的主要法規框架
blocks.en: Each chamber type maps to a different primary regulatory framework

blocks.zh: 在採購前寫好 URS。在使用前完成映射。在問題發生前定期複審。
blocks.en: Write the URS before purchase. Complete mapping before use. Review periodically before problems occur.
